en.answer:
Yes, it can.

In that case, the chosen monster is not sent to the Graveyard and it is banished instead by the effect of <<6682>>.
en.question: Can the effect of <<12234>> that sends monsters to the Graveyard be activated while the effect of <<6682>> is being applied?
en.title: Can the effect of <<12234>> that sends monsters to the Graveyard be activated while the effect of <<6682>> is being applied?

ja.answer:
「<<6682>>」の効果適用中に、「<<12234>>」のモンスターを墓地へ送る効果を発動する事はできます。

その場合、選んだモンスターは墓地へは送られず、「<<6682>>」の効果によって除外される事になります。
